Name: Luck Skill Starblue Style
Author: runangiejar
Description:
This mod was created just to give the Luck Skill visuals a Starblue-inspired palette. Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0?gameId=1303]spacechase0[/url] and Nykal145 for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/521]Luck Skill[/url]﻿ mod, and to Lita ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral]strangelyliteral[/url]﻿) and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony?gameId=1303]CherrySymphony[/url] for the gorgeous Starblue recolor. Both mods that I'm currently enjoying in my save.
